Yilwatda made the call at the party’s presidential campaign rally held at Azaria Road Stadium, Jos, Plateau state on Saturday.
In a statement by his Special Adviser on Media and Information Strategy, Abimbola Tooki, Yilwatda expressed satisfaction with the massive turnout and the renewed spirit of unity among APC leaders and supporters in Plateau State, describing the rally as a strong demonstration of the party’s growing cohesion and commitment to President Tinubu’s re-election.
He charged the people of Plateau State to translate the enthusiasm demonstrated at the rally into votes, insisting that the state must deliver a record-breaking electoral victory for President Tinubu.
The National Chairman reaffirmed that all political leaders in Plateau State were now united, 100 per cent, behind the President, assuring Mr President that the ballot box would reflect the people’s overwhelming support.
He also described President Tinubu as a promise keeper who has fulfilled the commitments he made to Plateau State, noting that the administration’s record of delivery provides a strong basis for renewed public confidence and support.
A major highlight of the rally was the presentation of APC flags to the party’s governorship candidates across the North Central states, symbolising the party’s determination to strengthen internal cohesion, consolidate its political structures and secure victory at all levels in the forthcoming elections.
Speaking on the occasion, Yilwatda specifically charged APC governors, governorship candidates and party leaders across the region to close ranks, bring every stakeholder on board and establish a united front behind President Tinubu.
He urged the Plateau State leadership to consolidate the unity already achieved and mobilise massively for President Tinubu and all APC candidates.
In Benue state, he called on the Governor and party leaders to harmonise all interests, unite the political stakeholders and mobilise the electorate for a resounding APC victory.
For Niger state, the National Chairman expressed confidence in the state leadership’s ability to use the party’s flag as a rallying point to unite members and deliver President Tinubu and all APC candidates.
Similarly, while presenting the party’s flag to its governorship candidate in Nasarawa state, he charged him and other party leaders to provide purposeful leadership, unite stakeholders and mobilise massive support for President Tinubu, while working towards greater prosperity, peace and development in the state.
Yilwatda emphasised that the North Central region must approach the forthcoming elections with a common purpose, stressing that personal interests and political differences must give way to the collective objective of securing victory for the APC.
He urged all party structures, elected officials, candidates and grassroots mobilisers to intensify engagement with the electorate and ensure that the enthusiasm witnessed in Jos translates into overwhelming votes across the region.
The National Chairman declared that the APC remains firmly committed to delivering President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and all its candidates across the North Central and the country.
“Our strength lies in our unity, our strategy is effective mobilisation, and our destination is victory. I therefore charge all our governors, governorship candidates and party leaders across the North Central to unite every stakeholder in their respective states and work together to deliver maximum votes for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.
“The Jos rally has demonstrated what we can achieve when we stand together. We must sustain this momentum, take our message to every community and ensure that our commitment to the President is reflected in our votes,”he said.
The APC National Chairman assured party members and supporters that the party would sustain its mobilisation drive, strengthen its structures and work collectively towards a decisive victory for President Tinubu and all APC candidates in 2027.
Also speaking, the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari said Plateau like every other northern state would give President Tinubu 101% support in the 2027 polls.
“Mr President, we knew the last election and today, Plateau can spoke and we can see with our own eyes what we are experiencing in Plateau. The key players, the active players in the Plateau politics are all here to give you the assurances that in 2027, Plateau is 101% assured.
“Not only because they give the assurance as the national chairman did but the developmental projects as they mentioned themselves. I am impressed to speak for us, to speak for you, to speak for the government as well as.
“We have ran with you and we thank you for driving us as our captain, captain of our plane and the captain of our ship. We believe strongly, God will see us through in 2027.
